newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Bosnia March output up 12.3 pct m/m, 52.9 y/y.
newsitem.headline: Bosnia March output up 12.3 pct m/m, 52.9 y/y.

text.p: The Statistics Buraeu of Bosnia's Moslem-Croat federation issued the following economic indicator details on Monday.
BOSNIA INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION MARCH FEB MARCH 96

NOTES -- The data cover 51 percent of the territory of Bosnia-Hercegovina. No data are available for remaining 49 percent. Bosnian industrial output is up 52.9 percent in Jan-March period compared to the same period in 1996, but March 1997 production is down 87.4 percent compared to the prewar March 1991 output, the office said.
BOSNIA RETAIL PRICES MARCH FEB MARCH 96

NOTES -- The data cover 51 percent of Bosnia-Hercegovina territory. Data for remaining 49 percent are not available. Retail prices in Jan-March 1997 rose by 10.9 percent compared to the same period in 1996, the office said.
INDUSTRIAL PRODUCER PRICES MARCH FEB MARCH 96
NOTES -- The data cover 51 percent of Bosnia-Hercegovina territory. Data for remaining 49 percent are not available. -- Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
